pages.text: $(thing)Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungi$() ($(o)Glomeromycota$()), symbiont.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() poaceae, fabaceae, solanaceae, amaryllidaceae, apiaceae, asteraceae, linaceae, malvaceae.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, root contact.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 2 years (spores and hyphae in soil).$(li)$(thing)Benefit:$() +30% to its host.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Reduced tillage; Avoid long bare fallows; Avoid very high phosphorus.
Brassicas and beets are non-hosts, so a cabbage or sugar beet crop lets the network decline.
